note: The sauce half is evidenced almost verbatim and the wheat is real: デミグラス is a brown roux, i.e. wheat flour cooked in fat, so this sauce is a genuine gluten source and worth stating plainly rather than as 'typically wheat-derived'. Two fixes: the article names 玉ねぎ, not daikon, in the おろしソース — say onion; and DELETE the tonjiru from the gluten sentence. 豚汁 is pork, root vegetables, dashi and miso; the article specifies nothing beyond 粉山椒, and tonjiru miso is ordinarily 米味噌, which is wheat- and barley-free. Calling the soup a gluten exposure warns a coeliac off the one part of the set that probably is not one.

why: Trading. The cited article is on a live, currently-maintained site (its sidebar links an article dated 2026年5月18日オープン) and prints 「■とん吉 075-721-0619 京都府京都市左京区一乗寺宮の東町51-5 12:00～15:00 17:00～22:00 木曜休み」; Tabelog agrees with 「12:00～15:00頃 17:30頃～22:00」 and marks 木 定休日, with reviews to 2025/03 across 190 reviews. FLAG: our record's hours_raw ('around 12:00–15:00; around 17:30–22:00') carries no closing day at all, and both sources say the shop is shut on Thursdays.

Trading, on the evidence available. The Tabelog listing is live with 定休日 火曜日 and hours posted, its most recent review is dated 2024/09, and an Ecosia sweep (Yahoo Japan not attempted; Ecosia answered first try) returns current Retty, Hot Pepper, Yahoo!マップ, グルコミ and e-NAVITA entries with no 閉店 notice on any of them. Note the review flow is thin (5 reviews), so this is 'no evidence of closure' rather than a fresh sighting. One small enrichment from that sweep: グルコミ records that the shop takes PayPay and 楽天ペイ as well as cash, and names 油淋鶏 and ちゃんぽん麺.

Trading. Reviews dated 2026/04, 2024/11 and 2024/05, and the listing carries current operator hours 「火・水・木・金 17:00 - 04:00 / 土・日・祝日 12:00 - 04:00 / 月 定休日（但し祝日の場合は翌日）」, matching our record. Also on the page and missing from our flags: 予約可, カード可 (JCB/AMEX/Diners), 全席喫煙可 — the whole shop is a smoking room, which is worth a traveller knowing before a 4 a.m. finish.

'ask' is defined in REVIEW_PROTOCOL as the honest default when evidence is thin, and here it is not thin — the operator is a Tabelog corporate member publishing a complete, dated food menu. All nine items are wheat: three sandwiches on コッペパン or 食パン, バタートースト, the モーニングプレート (トースト), and the デミオムライス whose デミグラスソース is a wheat roux. Nothing on the page offers or hints at gluten-free provision. There is nothing left to ask, which is what 'no' records; leaving it at 'ask' invites a coeliac to spend a visit finding out what the menu already says. Human gate applies either way — this is a recommendation only.
